title: Bredon sheaf cohomology
summary: For a finite group $G$, we compute the algebraic $K$-theory of the category of equivariant sheaves on a locally compact Hausdorff $G$-space, generalizing a result of Efimov, and determine the equivariant $E$-theory of the $C^*$-algebra of continuous functions. These invariants admit natural descriptions in terms of a new equivariant cohomology theory, which we call Bredon sheaf cohomology. This theory recovers classical Bredon cohomology for $G$-CW complexes and ordinary sheaf cohomology when $G$ is trivial.
